All 7 tests pass. Here's a summary of the three bugs fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — used `<=` which made touching intervals (e.g. `(540,600)` and `(600,660)`) appear overlapping. Changed to `<` so only intervals sharing at least one minute overlap.

2. **`merge_intervals`** — two issues: it mutated the input list via `.sort()` (violating the docstring "must not be modified") and used `<` instead of `<=` for the merge condition, preventing touching intervals from being merged. Fixed by sorting a copy and using `<=`.

3. **`find_free_slots`** — three issues: used `>` (strictly greater than) instead of `>=` (docstring says "A gap of exactly min_len minutes is long enough"), didn't clamp busy intervals to the `[day_start, day_end]` window (docstring says "parts...outside the day window are ignored"), and didn't check for a trailing gap after the last busy interval.
